name: Whiteland Westin Residences
summary: Confirmed: the project, developer (Whiteland Corporation, with Marriott/Westin), Sector 103 location, HARERA number RC/REP/HARERA/GGM/838/570/2024/65 and the starting price (Rs 6.3-7 Cr on portals). Land, towers and units are inconsistent. One source matches ours (6.15 acres, 12 towers, 1,302 units). Others say the project covers 21 acres in 13 towers, or 9 towers with 412 homes. The project is registered under three RERA numbers (65, 66 and 67 of 2024), and we list only #65.
